title: Light-Heart-Labs/DreamServer

description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: SametAtas/rein

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm

title: GhravenLabs/Agent-Meeting-Room

title: 23seriy/devops-ai-workflows

title: rohansurve212/gmail-calendar-agent

description: Autonomous AI agent managing Gmail and Google Calendar. It uses LLMs to identify invites, extract details, and manage scheduling by checking availability to automatically book meetings or reply if busy

title: mightbesaad/gvnr

title: Autonion/Automation-Companion

title: Ayushi22jain/Python-AI-Agent-

title: ShrutiShravani/GuardOps
